description:
Control a Sony INZONE headset from the tray or the command line, without INZONE Hub.

An open, unofficial reimplementation of INZONE Hub's device control: a tray application and a
command line tool for Windows. Talks to the INZONE USB dongle directly over the same vendor HID
channel INZONE Hub uses, so headphone volume, game/chat balance, microphone level and battery
can be read and changed without running Sony's own application.
